mapper.select: SELECT * FROM company_locations WHERE company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM company_locations WHERE company_id = #{companyId}
